Confirm details with organizers before going.

standing.title: Sokoji Wednesday zazen
standing.description: Soto Zen sitting in Japantown, recommended for beginners. Email info@sokoji.org before your first visit.

standing.title: SF Buddhist Center intro to meditation
standing.description: Drop-in beginner class at 37 Bartlett St, open to any level of experience.

standing.title: Trans Sangha Buddha Night
standing.description: Silent meditation for trans people at SF Zen Center. Beginners and newcomers always welcome.

standing.title: Meditation in Recovery
standing.description: A drop-in meditation meeting for people in recovery, at SF Zen Center and on Zoom.

standing.title: Grace Cathedral outdoor labyrinth
standing.description: Walk the Chartres-style labyrinth on Nob Hill as a moving meditation. One path, no dead ends; the indoor one is open during visiting hours.

standing.title: Endgames Saturday drop-in improv
standing.description: A different teacher and topic each week, no experience needed. $35, 2989 Mission St; buy ahead, since classes can be canceled for low enrollment.

standing.title: Leela Thursday drop-in improv
standing.description: Beginner-friendly drop-in at 450 Geary St. $25 the last time it was listed; confirm the current schedule before going.

standing.title: Free weekly music jams
standing.description: Bring an instrument or just listen. Mondays: jazz jam at Waystone (6pm), Dirty Works at Persona (8pm). Wednesdays: jazz jams at Stookey's Blue Room and the Lucky Horseshoe (8pm). Sundays: bluegrass at the Lucky Horseshoe and blues at Pier 23 (4pm).

standing.title: Open mic at The Riptide
standing.description: A free weekly open mic at an Outer Sunset honky-tonk bar near Ocean Beach.

standing.title: SF-Marin Food Bank volunteer shifts
standing.description: Pack food in a warehouse crew of strangers. Shifts are short and need no experience.

standing.title: GLIDE
standing.description: Serve meals in the Tenderloin. Sign up early for the holidays; spots fill fast.

standing.title: Dinner with Grace
standing.description: Cook at Grace Cathedral, then serve and share the meal with people moving out of homelessness at the Crosby.

standing.title: Presidio Habitat Stewards
standing.description: Restore native habitat at Lands End, Fort Funston, and the Presidio. Free and all-ages.

standing.title: Japanese Tea Garden free hour
standing.description: Free for everyone that hour (and always free for SF residents). Go slow.

standing.title: SF Rec & Park volunteer programs
standing.description: Gardening and park workdays across the city, including the Golden Gate Park EcoCenter.

standing.title: Little Brothers – Friends of the Elderly visiting volunteers
standing.description: Be matched with an older adult who lives alone and visit in person, or take them on outings. Virtual orientation and background check first.

standing.title: JFCS Friendly Visitors
standing.description: Weekly in-person visits with a senior who lives alone or is in palliative care. JFCS also needs help at its monthly Cafe by the Bay gatherings for Holocaust survivors.

standing.title: Institute on Aging Friendship Line
standing.description: Answer calls on a 24-hour warm line for isolated older adults: conversation, reassurance, and crisis support. Training provided.

standing.title: Meals on Wheels SF grocery drivers
standing.description: Deliver groceries to the same seniors each week and get to know them. Back-up driver, bag-packing, and card-making roles are also open.

standing.title: Curry Senior Center
standing.description: Serve breakfast or lunch, call bingo, or hand out groceries to Tenderloin seniors on Thursdays. The third-Friday Fiesta Karaoke also needs hands.

standing.title: Self-Help for the Elderly Thanksgiving luncheon
standing.description: Help serve Thanksgiving lunch at five senior centers across Chinatown, the Sunset, the Richmond, and the Excelsior. Year-round roles at senior centers too.

standing.title: On Lok companions
standing.description: One-on-one companionship, conversation, games, reading, and meal serving at On Lok's 30th Street Senior Center. Email to join an orientation.

standing.title: Shanti peer support & PAWS
standing.description: Be a one-on-one companion to an LGBTQ+ older adult or someone living with HIV or cancer, or help them keep their pets through PAWS.

standing.title: "In Their Name" altars at SOMArts
standing.description: Dozens of artists' ofrendas for the people they've lost. $15, free 16 and under.

standing.title: SF boards, commissions & task forces
standing.description: Apply for a seat helping run the city. Posted openings include the Elections Commission, Ballot Simplification Council, and Behavioral Health Council.

standing.title: NERT neighborhood volunteer coordinator
standing.description: Be the go-to contact for emergency volunteers on your block: recruit neighbors to the free NERT training, join drills, and help run a staging area after a disaster.

standing.title: Huckleberry Young Professionals Board
standing.description: Plan fundraisers, volunteer days, and partnerships for a youth development nonprofit. 21+, meetings mostly in SF; applications always open.

standing.title: GLIDE Young Professionals Committee
standing.description: Organize GLIDE's fundraisers, film nights, and volunteer days with other young professionals. Email youngprofessionals@glide.org to join.

standing.title: SF-Marin Food Bank peer navigator
standing.description: Guide neighbors at food markets to local services after 5 hours of training. 18+, stipend provided; Spanish or Cantonese a plus.

standing.title: SF City Guides walking-tour guide
standing.description: Train on eight Saturdays (Feb–May 2027), then lead free history walks at least 10 times a year. 18+, $295 enrollment fee.

standing.title: SF Symphony Volunteer Council
standing.description: Join a volunteer league that meets monthly and supports the Symphony with events and outreach, or usher at Davies Symphony Hall.

standing.title: SF Ballet BRAVO volunteers
standing.description: Usher at the Opera House or help ballet departments behind the scenes. 18+, references and background check; next intro meeting Jan 23, 2027.

standing.title: War Memorial ushering (Herbst Theatre & Opera House)
standing.description: Herbst Theatre takes walk-in ushers: arrive 90 minutes early in black and white with a flashlight. For the Opera House, email ushers@sfopera.com.

standing.title: SFJAZZ volunteer ushers
standing.description: Usher and help with front-of-house and events. 15 hours earns a membership; email volunteer@sfjazz.org.

standing.title: Asian Art Museum volunteers
standing.description: Welcome visitors at the info desk, help at First Free Sundays and family events, or do behind-the-scenes projects. 16+, one-year commitment, applications always open.

standing.title: California Academy of Sciences volunteers
standing.description: Dozens of roles, from docent and aquarium husbandry to NightLife ambassador. 18+; review can take up to two months.

standing.title: SF Zoo docents
standing.description: Lead conservation talks at the exhibits after a 10-week Sunday training starting Jan 31, 2027. 18+; email join@sfzoodocents.org.

standing.title: Gardens of Golden Gate Park volunteers
standing.description: Help in the nursery, gardens, library, and events at the Botanical Garden, Conservatory, and Japanese Tea Garden. Requires a Gardens membership and orientation.
